fullDesc: On February 6, 2023 two earthquakes of magnitude 7.8 and 7.5 struck southern Turkey and northern Syria, killing more than 50,000 people. Thousands of buildings collapsed, and many that failed had ignored building codes.
realFacts: It was among the deadliest quakes in the 21st century
Rescuers from dozens of countries helped
Turkey later arrested builders over unsafe construction
